timeline.summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance shareholders approved the appointment of Mr. Mukul Mathur as Independent Director via postal ballot on April 23, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹593.12 Cr (+22.5% YoY), net profit ₹260.95 Cr (+26.0% YoY).
Aptus Value Housing Finance reported Q4 FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹261 Cr up 26% YoY and AUM of ₹13,107 Cr.
Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited uploaded the Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 7, 2026, hosted by Sanin Panicker.
Mr. Munuswamy Anandan, Founder Promoter, declared no new encumbrance on Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited shares as of April 03, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Earnings Conference Call rescheduled to Wednesday, November 04, 2026, at 5:30 PM (IST).
